arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Joseffer argued that the Gross decision and 1991 amendments support the but-for standard.
Mr. Lauten argued that Congress would not create two standards without explicit language.
Ms. Arbus Sherry addressed why Congress might adopt different standards for different claims.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case asks whether a plaintiff must prove that retaliation was the sole cause of an adverse action. the side that brought the case argues the but-for standard applies. the opposing side argues a lesser standard applies.
